threads.body: If you add this here then it will be run when each key is created, perhaps it would be better to do this once in the constructor? It would be better to use `GlobalOpenTelemetry.getOrNoop()` since `GlobalOpenTelemetry.get()` prevents subsequent calls to `GlobalOpenTelemetry.set()`. Using the `GlobalOpenTelemetry` isn't guaranteed to work correctly for library instrumenations since they might not set it. To correctly handle library instrumenations you'd need to pass an `OpenTelemetry` instance to the constructor of `ServletRequestParametersExtractor`, but imo it isn't really important. The main idea behind this flag is to ease transitioning to the new defaults, so when we are finally ready to move to 3.0 we could search for the usages of this flag and flip the default instead of doing all these changes right before the release or maintaining a separate branch.
